description: This file declares the class 'em_cmd_get_network_t' which inherits from 'em_cmd_t'. It includes a constructor that retrieves network configuration parameters and updates a 'dm_easy_mesh_t' structure. The file serves as part of a command interface for network management within a mesh network system.

classes.name: em_cmd_get_network_t
classes.description: A class responsible for retrieving network configuration data as part of a command in the mesh network system.

methods.name: em_cmd_get_network_t
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command object to retrieve the network configuration, taking command parameters and a reference to the easy mesh data structure.
